div.div: غَلْظٌ Rough, or rugged, land or ground; (ISd, K;) mentioned on the authority of Ibn-'Abbád; and by AHn, on the authority of En-Nadr; but it has been repudiated: and is said to be correctly ↓ غِلَظٌ : ISd says, of the former word, “ I know not whether it be [properly] syn. with غَلِيظٌ, or whether it be an inf. n. used as an epithet: ” accord. to Kr, it signifies hard land without stones: Ks says that غَلْظٌ is syn. with ↓ غِلَظٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
